subject: Compliance deep-dive + action items for ACP Payments
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@acppayments.com>, Josh Kramer <jkramer@acppayments.com>
Cc: security@acppayments.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance deep-dive + action items for ACP Payments

Hi Laura / Josh —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from my side so we have a clear list of what we discussed and what we (Redwood) will deliver next:

Pain points you shared
- Need auditable, long-term audit logs (access + request traces) for regulatory e-discovery.
- Requirement to demonstrate SOC 2 controls and pen-test evidence to internal auditors.
- Data residency and retention policies (30/90/365 day buckets) with exportable retention proofs.
- Contract controls: DPA redline and security questionnaire responses are gating procurement.

Goals we heard
- Provide SOC 2 summary + representative evidence within 5 business days.
- Show sample audit log exports and how logs map to user/token actions.
- Decide whether Redwood Private (VPC) is required or Dedicated capacity meets needs.
- Target kickoff (PO / contract) by end of May if legal and infosec sign off.

What we'll deliver (next 3 working days)
1) Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf — high-level scope and applicable controls. (attached)
2) pen_test_exec_summary.pdf — executive summary of recent external test and remediation status. (attached)
3) audit_log_sample.csv — redacted sample showing timestamp, request id, model, token counts, and approximate cost trace. (attached)
4) DPA_draft_ACP.docx — starting point for your legal team; please flag top 3 must-have clauses and we will prioritize.

Proposed next steps
- Tech walkthrough with our security/solutions engineer (Priyom) week of May 17 — 45 minutes to walk the audit log schema and retention/export flows.
- Legal redline window: please send initial DPA comments by May 20 so we can route to our legal.
- If you want Dedicated or Private pricing/options, Vanessa will send a short options matrix and cost delta.

Open questions for you
- Who is the primary infosec reviewer for evidence (name + email)?
- Any minimum retention policy (e.g., 365 days) that is a must for contract?

I cc'd our security and solutions leads so they're in the loop. I'll follow up with the requested artifacts in the first half of Monday.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

--
Attachments referenced: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf, pen_test_exec_summary.pdf, audit_log_sample.csv, DPA_draft_ACP.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura@acppayments.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Josh Kramer <jkramer@acppayments.com>, ACP Payments Security <security@acppayments.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance deep-dive + action items for ACP Payments

Thanks Jonas — helpful recap. A few clarifications before we dive into the artifacts:

1) Retention: We have two programs — transaction-level logs (retain 365 days) and operational logs (retain 90 days). Is that configuration available out-of-the-box or would that require Private deployment?

2) Audit logs: do the logs include token-level cost attribution (per request token counts mapped to customer IDs) or would that need additional instrumentation? We need to show auditors cost attribution for a given customer request.

3) Pen test: can you confirm scope (external network + app level vs internal/cloud config)? If there's an NDA-protected full report, an exec summary will work for our auditors.

4) DPA: we'll pass your draft to legal. Any non-negotiables from your side we should be aware of up front?

We have a security reviewer lined up — me and Josh will shepherd legal (Laura.bennett@acppayments.com and j.kramer@acppayments.com).

Can we schedule the technical walkthrough for May 18 or 19 (preferred mornings PST)?

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Security | ACP Payments
laura@acppayments.com | +1 212-555-0133

Forwarded message excerpt: On Mon, May 10, 2027 at 9:04 AM Laura Bennett <laura@acppayments.com> wrote: "A few clarifications before we dive into the artifacts..."

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@acppayments.com>
Cc: Josh Kramer <jkramer@acppayments.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, ACP Payments Security <security@acppayments.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance deep-dive + action items for ACP Payments

Hi Laura / Josh —

Appended below are the artifacts and short answers to your questions. We kept answers concise; happy to expand in the walkthrough.

Attachments sent (zipped for email delivery):
- Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf — scope, controls mapped to common auditor asks.
- pen_test_exec_summary.pdf — scope: external network + app-level + cloud configuration review; only exec summary included in this send. Full report is shared under NDA.
- audit_log_sample.csv — redacted example: columns = timestamp, request_id, user_id, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, estimated_cost_usd, region, note.
- DPA_draft_ACP.docx — redline-ready doc.

Answers to your clarifying questions
1) Retention: our Hosted offering supports configurable buckets up to 365 days for audit logs. For customers that require isolated infrastructure or longer retainment with legal controls, Dedicated or Private is available. No code change required — policy configuration + retention export handles it.

2) Audit logs / token-level cost attribution: yes — logs include tokens_in/tokens_out and an estimated_cost_usd column that we can map to customer request IDs. We can also pull aggregated token/cost reports per customer for auditor requests.

3) Pen test scope: as noted — external + application + cloud config. The exec summary contains dates, scope, and remediation status. Full technical findings are only released under NDA.

4) DPA / non-negotiables: our standard DPA covers data processing, subprocessor list, breach notification windows, and limited liability clauses. We typically push back on broad indemnity language and high-dollar liquidated damages. If ACP has three top-priority redlines, share them and I will escalate.

Proposed next steps
- Schedule May 18 or May 19 (mornings PST) for the 45m technical walkthrough with Priyom — please confirm preferred time.
- Legal: Laura, if you can share initial redlines by May 20 we will route to our legal and aim to have a counter within 3 business days.
- Pricing: Vanessa will follow with the options matrix and estimated delta for Dedicated/Private.

If it helps, here's a quick HubSpot link with the deal notes: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/ACPP-2027-042
And a drive folder with the artifacts: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-acp-compliance

Looking forward to the walkthrough. Thanks again for the clear list of priorities — makes it straightforward to get you the right artifacts.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
